scope: Development tests and fixtures, standalone desktop preview source, and project maintenance documents supporting the immutable Chem source snapshot.

excludedUpstreamFiles.reason: Publication-specific ignore rules are maintained separately for the nested Chem project.
The parent repository preserves exact Chem snapshot and fixture bytes with -text. The upstream nested file would override that policy and enable newline conversion.

notes: The immutable 254-file scientific source snapshot and its manifest are unchanged.
Development fixtures are transformed software test copies where marked. Original source hashes and published hashes are distinct. Original source files remain unchanged.

Historical host paths were replaced with a synthetic fixture root; the installed file inventory was minimized to the bound basis entry and an inert synthetic placeholder. Dependent fixture hashes and test pins were recomputed, preserving geometry and coordinate number tokens.
Fixtures cannot establish scientific acceptance, installed runtime availability, or execution approval.
Installed environments, backend binaries, build output, caches, generated desktop runtime configuration, and scratch files are excluded.
